description: Soft-spoken courier-hold scam: polite tone, 'confidentiality', clearance charges.

events.text: Good morning sir, kindly stay on the line, our senior will connect you shortly. Your parcel is on hold at customs.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: For confidentiality of the investigation please do not share these details with anybody. Clearance charges have to be paid today to release the consignment.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Please transfer the clearance charges to the account I am sharing, upi id clear dot parcel at ybl
events.speaker: caller
